title: Actively maintained replication code and reproducibility report for Coppock, Green, and Porter (2026), Quarterly Journal of Political Science
description:
Actively maintained replication code and reproducibility report for Coppock, Green, and Porter (2026), Quarterly Journal of Political Science.

The maintained version rewrites the analysis code so that it runs on current R and current packages, operating directly on the cleaned data as originally deposited (the deposit ships only cleaned data, so the cleaning code is outside the rewrite). The repository also holds the ground truth comparing the article's numerical claims in the text against the archival and maintained code, a check of each rebuilt figure against the published version, and the itemized errata. This record's concept DOI always resolves to the latest version.
